source: Authenticated Google AI Studio UI, directly observed after the owner changed the selected account
binding_method: The existing runtime credential was matched to its project-labelled AI Studio details and the existing credential policy. Only the check result is retained here; no credential value, fingerprint, account or project identifier is added to this public receipt.

usage_observation.metric: maximum observed use in the selected window, not an authoritative remaining balance

capacity.reason: 20 RPD is a recurring limit, not a reliability guarantee. At two longs/day and three Short candidates/long, nominal designated reviews need 8 calls/day; one retry per file needs 16 before backlog or corrections. Current legacy retries and shared usage are not a proven global daily budget. Native real delivery and sustained throughput remain unqualified.
